title: TensorPlate CLI JSON Output Envelope
description: Stable machine-readable output envelope used by `tensorplate` subcommands when `--output json` is selected. The envelope is intentionally narrow: a coarse `status`, an optional typed `error`, the active correlation/transaction id, and a command-specific `payload` whose shape is documented by each subcommand. The envelope is versioned so V01-E15 validation scripts can rely on stable field names.

payload.description: Command-specific payload. See per-command docs in `docs/cli/`. Always present on `status=ok` results; absent or null on errors.
